steps.title: Configure project build settings and dependencies
steps.description: Set up build.gradle scripts targeting Android SDK 34 with Java 8 compatibility and NanoHTTPD dependency.

steps.title: Define app manifest permissions and service declarations
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with foreground service, media playback permissions, and activity configuration flags.

steps.title: Define UI color palette, themes, and string resources
steps.description: Create custom dark theme resources, button styles, and string values matching YouTube design system.

steps.title: Create navigation control drawables and icons
steps.description: Generate rounded background shape XML and vector icons for playback, navigation, and deletion controls.

steps.title: Build main activity user interface layout
steps.description: Design main XML layout featuring custom top navigation toolbar, loading progress bar, webview frame, and offline error view.

steps.title: Design watch history UI layout and list item views
steps.description: Create layouts for watch history screen with clear history action header and custom list item representation.

steps.title: Implement SQLite database helper for watch history persistence
steps.description: Develop SQLiteOpenHelper class to store, retrieve, delete single items, and clear all YouTube watch history entries.

steps.title: Implement watch history list adapter and history activity
steps.description: Build custom BaseAdapter to display history records with formatted dates and handle item selection and clearing callbacks.

steps.title: Implement persistent foreground audio background service
steps.description: Create BackgroundAudioService with MediaSession integration, audio focus management, wake lock handling, and notification controls.

steps.title: Implement JavaScript visibility override injection and bridge
steps.description: Add JavascriptInterface and dynamic script injection into WebView to bypass background visibility pause triggers on YouTube web player.

steps.title: Implement background task management and activity lifecycle protection
steps.description: Override onBackPressed to move task to back and handle task removal in service to ensure continuous audio playback when minimized.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Final project build and verification of YouTube Background Player.
